Spiked_Mantis_Claws.description: The Spiked Mantis Claws are formidable insectoid appendages, exuding a menacing presence with their jagged, razor-sharp edges that gleam with a predatory sheen, enhancing their wielder's strength and agility while granting the deadly skills of Bleed Procc and Sunder.

Grasping_Spider_Leg_Arms.description: Sinuous and eerily flexible, these Grasping Spider Leg Arms are covered in fine, sticky hairs that allow them to scale sheer surfaces effortlessly, while their sharp claws and adhesive pads enable a deadly grip and snare foes in tangled webs.

Heavy_Beetle_Pincer_Arms.description: Equipped with massive, chitin-reinforced pincers that serve as both arms and armor, these appendages are the embodiment of brute strength and resilience, granting their wielder immense power and the ability to weather even the heaviest of blows while delivering crushing strikes that can bring down the mightiest of foes.

Acid_Spraying_Ant_Forelegs.description: Equipped with razor-sharp, segmented forelegs, these insectoid arms are tipped with glands that secrete a caustic acid capable of dissolving flesh and armor alike, while granting the wielder increased dexterity and resilience against the toxins they wield.

Luminescent_Firefly_Graspers.description: The Luminescent Firefly Graspers are delicate yet formidable insectoid arms, their translucent appendages pulsating with an otherworldly glow that shifts through the spectrum of colors, mesmerizing those who dare to gaze upon them. These magical limbs not only enhance the wielder's charm and wisdom but also grant them the ability to emit a radiant light and lure creatures with an irresistible enchantment.

Barbed_Centipede_Claws.description: The Barbed_Centipede_Claws are a pair of agile and venomous appendages, each joint bristling with razor-sharp barbs that leave trails of toxic ichor upon contact, granting their wielder heightened dexterity and a measure of brute strength while enabling the use of deadly skills like Poison Cloud and Bleed Procc.

Delicate_Moth_Forelegs.description: These ethereal forelegs, delicate as the finest silk, are imbued with arcane energy, enhancing the wearer's wisdom and perception to detect subtle magical currents and allowing them to hover gracefully above the ground.

Subterranean_Mole_Cricket_Diggers.description: Equipped with powerful, shovel-like front limbs, the Subterranean Mole Cricket's diggers are both a marvel and a terror, capable of effortlessly tunneling through earth while delivering devastating blows that can knock even the hardiest of foes to the ground.

Ghost_Mantis_Spectral_Scythes.description: The Ghost Mantis Spectral Scythes are ghostly appendages that shimmer in the dim light, their spectral blades whispering through the air with deadly precision, granting their wielder unparalleled stealth and dexterity, while also allowing them to see through the shadows and inflict grievous, bleeding wounds upon their foes.

Parasitic_Wasp_Stinger_Arms.description: Emerging from the flesh of the host, these arms are slender and segmented like those of a parasitic wasp, dripping with venomous secretions that can incapacitate foes with a mere touch, while their agile movements and relentless speed grant the bearer an edge in combat's unpredictable dance.
